title: WorldPainter hover outline shows an NxN brush under tools that ignore brush size

sections.what: The brush hover outline is drawn for every tool, so after setting a 5x5 brush for Paint, switching to Area, Feature, Select or Inspect still shows a 5x5 dashed box under the cursor. Those tools act on one cell, so the outline promises a footprint the click does not use.
sections.why: Reported by the author: the brush size 'stays that size' after leaving Paint/Erase. Traced in editor.ts: the stage mousemove handler sets state.brushHover = _brushCells(...) with no tool check, and _brushCells reads the single shared state.brush. Placement is NOT affected: placeFeature posts one x,y to /grid/place. Route legitimately uses the brush (applyRoute widens the trail on purpose, 'a 3x3 brush turns a 1-cell line into a 3-wide river'), so Route must keep it. The defect is the preview lying, not a wrong placement.
sections.how: Add a helper that says which tools consume the brush (paint, erase, route) and have the mousemove handler compute brushHover from _brushCells only for those tools; for every other tool the hover is the single cell under the pointer. Do not clamp state.brush itself and do not add a per-tool size, so returning to Paint keeps the author's chosen size. Rebuild static/js/worldpainter/editor.js with python tools/ts_convert.py build-one.

acceptance.text: With a 5x5 brush set, the hover outline under Area, Feature, Select, Inspect and Move is one cell.
Under Paint, Erase and Route the outline still follows the chosen brush size.
Switching Paint -> Area -> Paint keeps the 5x5 brush selected.
A unit test in tools/unit/test_worldpainter.js asserts which tools consume the brush.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: WorldPainter, any scope with a grid, left tool rail and canvas

Current availability: The fix is implemented in `editor.ts`, compiled to `editor.js`, guarded by unit tests in `test_worldpainter.js`, and live-verified via browser driver.

Live steps when available:
1. Open WorldPainter on deep_woods, choose Paint, set the brush to 5x5, then press A for the Area tool and hover the canvas. expected: a one-cell outline. observed before fix: a 5x5 outline.
2. Press P and hover. expected: the 5x5 outline is back.

This section defines intended access and live acceptance. It is not a claim that planned UI exists or works today. Current availability says what is implemented and verified now; the numbered steps say how to reach and test the intended surface once it is available.
custom.progress_2026_10_19:
Implemented in editor.ts: \_toolUsesBrush()\ (paint, erase, route) gates the hover footprint in the stage mousemove handler, and \_selectTool\ clears \brushHover\ so a tool switch does not leave the previous footprint on screen. Compiled with build-one. 1 source-wiring test added to tools/unit/test_worldpainter.js (passes).

**Not yet verified live.** The test asserts the code is present, not that the outline is one cell under the Area tool in a browser. Acceptance stays unticked until someone runs the browser steps above. Placement itself was never affected (placeFeature posts one cell), so no placement behavior changed.
